== Title ==
<span lang="ja">いよいよ決着をつける時が来た</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-271o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワンが同じ位置カード上にいる時に使う。１フォース消費して決闘を行う。ライト・セーバーを持っているジェダイは戦闘値が＋２される。敗者は除外カードとなり、残りのゲームの間、同じ人物を表すカードは配備できなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワン・ケノービは、デス・スターのハンガー・ベイ３２７付近にてライトセーバーで最期の決闘を行った。「修行半ばで貴様の下を去ったが、今やすべてを極めた。」</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' The Time Has Finally Come to Settle This.

'''Card text:''' Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are at the same site. Use 1 Force to duel. A Jedi with a lightsaber adds 2 to their duel total. The loser is placed out of play, and cards representing the same person cannot deploy for the rest of the game.

'''Lore:''' Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought their final lightsaber duel near Death Star Hangar Bay 327. “I left you before my training was complete, but now I have mastered everything.”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 6

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
